about: AI-1 test cases for the values side of the template's next version (ai1/spec-values.md): the requirement table's changed cells and the rules that read them. Computed with nextbuild/eval/sheval_next.py 2026-10-20.1 (round_mode decimal15) on the base dump dump-18OCT26-20261019 + every op of the composed candidate ai1/candidate/changes.candidate.json. Group 'table': one case per changed data cell, at the default inputs (inputs {}), its expected value in 'outputs' (the rule cells AE52 and AF56 at E3 blank; group '5f' varies E3). The other groups: inputs -> 'outputs' (s01 minimums C, maximums E, range highs AP, lower band edges Q to AO where listed, G4 and C11, s02 cells where listed) and 'descriptors' (the L or N text and the AR sentence of each row with an entry). Inputs not listed are the candidate's defaults: O1 'NRC RA Dog Maintenance', B3 15, E3 blank, G3 0, K3 0, M3 'None', B4 'Average laboratory or active (130 * kg BW^0.75)', D4 'Not selected or a cat', K4 blank, G10 and G130 blank, every entry in G and I blank. Values: number, text, true/false, null (blank) or {"error": code}. 'flags': the evaluator's assumption flags per cell (ai1/README.md). 'old': the 18OCT26 value (base dump, same inputs) of each output that changed (AR sentences aside); 'changed_from_18OCT26' lists them. Compare numbers with a relative tolerance of 1e-12, texts exactly.

groups.table: every s02 data cell (rows 5-157, the maximum-type codes AU:BO and their headers) and s01 K69 the candidate changes, with its expected value at the default inputs
groups.5a5b: AAFCO cat phosphorus maximum 5 g/Mcal and Ca:P minimum 1 (5a A), the Ca:P range high 2 x the minimum (5b A, s01 K69 = 2), band edges and descriptors; controls where K69 is not used
groups.5e: FEDIAF Cat Reproduction maximums: arginine 8.75, methionine 3.25, tryptophan 4.25, Ca:P 1.5
groups.choline: the choline maximum 500 mg/Mcal for the four NRC dog requirements (none elsewhere), the 340 mg/Mcal minimum for the NRC puppies and late gestation (3c B), under G10 blank, 25 and 55
groups.4c: NRC RA Cat Peak Lactation pantothenic acid MBW minimum 0.31 mg/kg BW^0.67 (s02 AQ97), converted with the energy
groups.5f: FEDIAF Dog Late Growth (>/= 14 wk): calcium minimum 2 or 2.5 g/Mcal and Ca:P maximum 1.8 or 1.6 from the expected mature BW in E3 (N(E3) in (0, 15] or not)
groups.item18: the energy and MBW rows' summary sentences (AR) quoting N4, the intake below the calculated requirement, in item 18's wording, and the M4 label
groups.mbw: FEDIAF adult MBW minimums (Table VII-11, 4d B) and MBW maximums (per-Mcal maximum x MER / 1,000, 8a B) converted with BW and the energy (K4 blank, below and above the MER requirement); the NRC MBW rows removed under 4a D
